name: Reese McIntosh Rowling
profile: Geologist and Corpus Christi oilman (born 1928, Waycross, Georgia) who co-founded Tana Oil and Gas in 1972, later sold to Texaco; father of Robert Rowling (TRT Holdings). Died in 2001.
notes: Deceased (2001) per Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reese_Rowling . Family wealth now associated with son Robert Rowling / TRT Holdings.

name: Patrick Bowlen
profile: Longtime owner of the NFL's Denver Broncos (from 1984), winning three Super Bowls. Died June 13, 2019, aged 75; team later sold to the Walton-Penner group in 2022.
